test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order. E sits second to the left of C. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and G. G is an immediate neighbour of E. Only two persons sit between E and H. B is an immediate neighbour of D. Only one person sits between Band F. What is the position of D with respect to H in the above arrangement?
solution:
**A, B, C, D, E, F, G and H **are sitting around a circular table facing the centre, but not necessarily in the same order. 

1. E sits second to the left of C. 

2. C is an immediate neighbour of both A and G. 

3. G is an immediate neighbour of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c59a841b2a69f5855f9e6a073715286276cda6b1c70959b297d293b2758d3b3.png] 

4. Only two persons sit between E and H. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/23c967c53b8d7aaf57c222dd081879432e059451abccc872588c84ba55690efa.png] 

5. B is an immediate neighbour of D. 

6. Only one person sits between Band F. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a512ba5951156915110f5b7884e850a442ce75a7843cd8fdcc1de11e055a1fa5.png] 

D is second to the right of H in the above arrangement.

Hence, '**Second to the right**' is the correct answer.
